{{Quote|We've been working with biotoxins, viruses native to Nar Shaddaa that are highly communicable and lethal to every sentient species we've tested.|Doctor [[Rassan]]|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''ChemFlex Labs''' was a laboratory of [[ChemFlex]] located in the [[Republic Research Division]] of the [[Ternion Building]], on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Empire sent [[Xenobi]] to attack and sabotage the Labs; however, the Xenobi thugs released biotoxins that ChemFlex was studying, and they were infected along with the lab animals. The infected were wiped out by Republic forces in order to prevent the spread of the viruses.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
ChemFlex Labs appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
